project.description: Freestyle experiment: codesign /bin/ls copy WITHOUT keychain partition list (issue #4)

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -u export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:$PATH" VARIANT="NOPARTITION" echo "=== codesign freestyle experiment: $VARIANT ==="
KC="codesign-freestyle-${BUILD_NUMBER}-${VARIANT}" rm -f ./ls-binary-test
security delete-keychain "$KC" 2>/dev/null || true if ! security create-keychain -p "$P12_PASS" "$KC"; then echo "FAIL: create-keychain"; exit 2 fi security unlock-keychain -p "$P12_PASS" "$KC" if ! security import "$P12_FILE" -k "$KC" -P "$P12_PASS" -T /usr/bin/codesign -f pkcs12; then echo "FAIL: p12 import"; exit 2 fi
# codesign resolves identities via the user search list; --keychain alone is not enough security list-keychains -d user -s "$KC" ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db
echo "--- skipping set-key-partition-list (experiment variable) ---"
IDENT=$(security find-identity -p codesigning "$KC" | awk '/^[[:space:]]*[0-9]+[)]/{print $2; exit}') echo "identity hash: ${IDENT:-NONE}" [ -n "$IDENT" ] || { echo "FAIL: no identity in keychain"; security delete-keychain "$KC"; exit 2; }
cp /bin/ls ./ls-binary-test
RC_SIGN=99 echo "--- codesign attempt (300s watchdog in case of securityd GUI-prompt hang) ---" codesign --force --sign "$IDENT" --keychain "$KC" --timestamp=none ./ls-binary-test > codesign-output.txt 2>&1 & CODESIGN_PID=$! ( sleep 300; kill -9 "$CODESIGN_PID" 2>/dev/null ) & WATCHDOG_PID=$! wait "$CODESIGN_PID" RC_SIGN=$? kill "$WATCHDOG_PID" 2>/dev/null echo "codesign rc=$RC_SIGN (124/137 = killed by watchdog)"
RC_VERIFY=99 if [ "$RC_SIGN" -eq 0 ]; then echo "--- verify ---" codesign -dv ./ls-binary-test 2>&1 | head -6 RC_VERIFY=0 else echo "verify skipped (sign failed)" fi
security list-keychains -d user -s ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db security delete-keychain "$KC" 2>/dev/null || true rm -f ./ls-binary-test
echo "" echo "================ RESULT ================" echo "variant=$VARIANT codesign_rc=$RC_SIGN verify_rc=$RC_VERIFY" if [ "$RC_SIGN" -eq 0 ]; then echo "VERDICT: SIGNING SUCCEEDED" else echo "VERDICT: SIGNING FAILED (expected for this variant if partition list is required)" fi
